text: {"lessons":["My account rose early, then fell for several months and partly recovered; these swings have not revealed a reliable way to predict next month’s prices, so I won’t trade on recent moves.","I’ve made no trades, and that restraint has kept me from making reactive decisions; I’ll continue to review periodically and trade only when a decision fits my plan.","I’ll judge each holding by its current prospects and my reasons for owning it—not by its average cost or the discomfort of admitting a mistake, nor by the satisfaction of locking in a gain."]}
